name: hv-host-1
question: Do the hypervisor (Firecracker or Cloud Hypervisor, with the same devices) and the host kind (a nested m8i.4xlarge or a whole m8i.metal-48xl) change the density per host vCPU that meets the targets, and the cost per 1,000 tasks? The mmio spec shows whether Firecracker's devices alone move the result.

why.firecracker-nested: Firecracker on the nested host every earlier campaign used, with the devices Cloud Hypervisor always has.
why.firecracker-nested-mmio: Firecracker as cap-baseline-1 ran it, to show whether the devices alone move the result.
why.cloud-hypervisor-nested: Cloud Hypervisor on the same nested host, so the nested pair differs only in the hypervisor.
why.firecracker-metal: The whole metal host, with no nested virtualization underneath; its ladder steps by 12 through the same 0.5 to 0.75 per host vCPU where the nested host turned from pass to fail, and goes on to 1.0.
why.cloud-hypervisor-metal: Cloud Hypervisor on the whole metal host, the pair that says which hypervisor to run in production.
